title: Cinematic Weather
description: Adds immersive visual wind, realistic falling leaves, storm, and dynamic camera shake effects
body:
# Cinematic Weather

**Cinematic Weather** is a client-side mod that brings your Minecraft weather and wind to life with beautiful effects, sounds, and physical reactions.

> ⚠️ **Highly recommended to play with Sodium!** Without it, severe storms may cause lag due to particle density.

---

## Features
* 🌀 **Realistic Wind & Leaves:** Leaves drift, spin, and sway naturally along with wind currents. Includes 4 different pixel-art leaf shapes.
* 🍂 **No Stuck Particles:** Floating leaves disappear instantly when colliding with the ground or trees instead of spinning awkwardly in place.
* 🌳 **Dynamic Biome Colors:** Leaves match the surrounding trees: dark pine needles in taiga, vibrant green in jungle, muddy green in swamps, dry golden-orange in savanna.
* ⚡ **Storms & Hurricanes:** Heavy storms push dropped items and the player, shake the screen gently, spawn sandstorms in deserts, and throw flying debris/blocks in the air.
* 🔊 **Spatial Leaf Rustling:** Walk near tree leaves during wind to hear spatial rustling sounds. Standing under a roof muffles weather sounds and blocks wind forces/particles.
* ⚙️ **Smart Optimization:** The mod **does not spawn particles behind your back** (out of sight), saving your FPS and memory.
* 🔧 **Easy In-Game Menu:** Customize leaf density (from 0 to 10 for massive falls), leaf size, and wind volume via ModMenu.

---

## Commands
You can also use the `/cw` command in chat to control the wind and test presets:

* `/cw status` - View current wind strength, direction, shelter factor, and active storm status.
* `/cw wind <strength> <yaw>` - Override and set custom wind strength (0.0 to 3.0) and direction angle (0 to 360 degrees).
* `/cw wind clear` - Revert wind to normal simulation.
* `/cw storm start <intensity> <duration_seconds>` - Start a custom cinematic storm.
* `/cw storm stop` - Stop the active storm.
* `/cw preset <low/medium/high/ultra>` - Instantly apply performance presets.
* `/cw leafdensity <multiplier>` - Adjust leaf density multiplier directly.
* `/cw testmode <true/false>` - Enable test mode for rapid storm cycle testing.
